To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the new anticancer drugs CLOF, FP and NEL have potential for use in ALL.

(a) CLOF is a potent inhibitor of DNA replication, (b) NEL is a potent inhibitor in T‐ALL but less so in B‐line ALL, (c) FP is a potent inhibitor, and (d) all three agents have a distinct resistance profile.
